import arena, subprocess, sys
n=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 1
secs=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '60'
for i in range(n):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 p=subprocess.run(['./think',b.fen(),secs],capture_output=True,text=True)
 print('\n'.join(p.stdout.splitlines()[-4:]),flush=True)
 move=p.stdout.split('bestmove ')[-1].strip()
 if move not in [m.uci() for m in b.legal_moves]:
  print('ILLEGAL',move);break
 arena.cmd_move(move)
 sys.stdout.flush()
PY
